name: Can grab bars be mounted if there are no studs directly behind the desired spot?

mainEntity.name: Can grab bars be mounted if there are no studs directly behind the desired spot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If structural wall framing does not align with your preferred bar location, professionals use specialized heavy-duty hollow-wall anchors rated specifically for grab bars and tile. These mechanical anchors expand behind the backer board and drywall to provide the required structural hold. Alternatively, during a broader bathroom renovation or drywall repair, custom horizontal wood blocking can be framed between the existing wall studs before the wallboard and tile are installed, allowing bars to mount anywhere securely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Contractors use heavy-duty structural anchors rated for grab bars, or open the wall to install custom wood blocking between studs during a remodel.
